cooked: Mempool policy should stay separate from consensus validity: committee rotation can affect propagation and inclusion latency, but it shouldn’t change which UTXO spends are valid. Specify deterministic conflict handling and expiry, then test a partition where a transaction reaches only one committee member. Also document the fault assumption and view-change path; a quorum threshold alone doesn’t establish liveness under a stalled or equivocating leader.
topic_title: Evaluating Deterministic BFT Finality within a Confidential UTXO State Machine
